highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with updated Linux, GTK4, Tizen, and WebAssembly support.
highlights_body: The release adds GTK4 GPU rendering and scaling, restores system-font discovery for no-dependencies Linux deployments, and aligns native assets with current platform toolchains.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to m156 and integrates the current core-fork cleanup.
No-dependencies Linux deployments can again discover system fonts without bundling the optional native dependency set.

bullets.lead: GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling
bullets.detail: GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with correct pixel scaling for sharper output on high-density displays.
Updates .NET 11 preview and WebAssembly assets, requires the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 build toolchain, and restores the WinUI Windows SDK default.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for no-dependencies deployments

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 opens the 4.156 line with Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and pixel scaling, Linux system-font discovery, and updated platform toolchains.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 aligns its native assets and build configuration with the .NET 11 preview and current platform toolchains.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 updates to Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU rendering and refreshed platform support.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: It restores Linux system-font discovery for no-dependencies deployments and aligns WebAssembly and Tizen native assets with current toolchains.
